title: Contact Fano manifolds and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture
summary: We resolve the contact-Fano homogeneity conjecture and the Riemannian LeBrun–Salamon conjecture positively. Every smooth connected complex projective contact Fano manifold of complex dimension at least three, with its given contact distribution, is contact-isomorphic to the adjoint variety of a simple complex Lie algebra. Consequently, every closed connected smooth positive quaternionic-Kähler manifold of real dimension $`4m\geq8`$ is homothetic to a compact symmetric Wolf space.
family_title: Projective contact classification and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture

review.reason: Classifies contact Fano manifolds and resolves the LeBrun-Salamon conjecture in quaternionic-Kahler geometry.
